full_name: Kelly Wisecup | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Humanities Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow Northwestern University
bio: Kelly Wisecup is a literary and cultural historian whose research examines Indigenous books and archives from the 18th century to the present and their intersections with histories of sovereignty, race and Indigeneity, and science and colonialism. At Radcliffe, she is writing a book about Indigenous birch bark bookmaking as environmental protest.
